title: UTSAAH 3.0
subtitle: Mental Health Awareness Campaign
description: UTSAAH 3.0 is an inspiring mental health awareness campaign by Psychologs, brought to MLRIT by The Third Space. Featuring an expert keynote dialogue with psychologist Mr. John Hemanth Kumar, art therapy sessions, and a student open sanctuary.
teaserSummary: Telangana's premier student mental health initiative bringing expert dialogues and creative expression to MLRIT.

successStory.headline: A Campus United for Mental Wellbeing
successStory.summary: UTSAAH 3.0 brought together students across all departments to openly talk about stress, emotional resilience, and connection through guided creative activities.

title: Metamorphosis Edition I
subtitle: Art Gathering & Creative Circles
description: Our inaugural on-campus gathering dedicated to creative expression through painting, tactile sketch circles, and candid peer conversations.
teaserSummary: The inaugural art gathering that founded The Third Space community sanctuary.

successStory.headline: Where The Third Space Community Began
successStory.summary: Our first gathering proved that when students have an open, non-judgmental space with paints, canvas, and listening ears, healing happens naturally. 29 unique photographs and artworks were preserved in the permanent archive.
